svg.title: Sketch: what Krusgraph builds in your Fabric
svg.desc: A hand-drawn sketch inside a dashed boundary marked Your Fabric tenant. Sources: SAP, Salesforce, Dynamics and more sources, brought in by mirroring or shortcuts. Then bronze (a lakehouse, raw), silver (a notebook, keys checked) and gold (views, a star schema), joined by arrows. Below, a dashed box: data products in the domain Sales, with the cards Customer, Product and Order, each with a key, an owner and a contract; interface arrows lead into Product. What people use: a semantic model, an ontology, a data agent, a report and a GraphQL API. Around it: a pipeline, dbt tests, the catalog, domains, alerts and Fabric Git. Same plan, same items; every change is a pull request. Colours: coral is raw, amber is refined, purple is a data product, teal is what people use, gray is run and govern.
svg.text: Same plan, same items · every change is a PR
